JOB DESCRIPTION
Linux | Windows Administrator

Managing the Linux Servers
Monitoring the servers for utilization of resources.
Troubleshooting issues
Writing scripts to automate processes.
Regular Patching/Upgrading the OS
Generating Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, YoY reports of
resource utilization
OpenShift :
Deploy, configure, and maintain OpenShift
Performance, and resource utilization.
Implement security measures and best practices for OpenShift
deployments.
Troubleshoot
and
resolve
issues
related
to
OpenShift
infrastructure and applications.

Experience
with
OpenShift
Container
Platform
(OCP)
administration and deployment.
Familiarity with OpenShift's command-line interface (oc) and web
console.
Knowledge of Kubernetes concepts and principles.
IBM MDM Deployment and Configuration:
Deploy and configure IBM MDM applications within OpenShift
environments.
Manage MDM server instances, including configuration, updates,
and patching.
Integrate MDM applications with other systems, such as
databases and message queues.
Monitor the performance and availability of MDM applications.
Develop and implement solutions for MDM data governance and
quality.
Experience with IBM MDM (InfoSphere MDM) deployment,
configuration, and administration.
Understanding of MDM data governance and master data
management concepts.
Experience with MDM server configuration and integration with
other systems.
